hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$(basename "$f")" in go.mod|go.sum) echo 'blocked: babylon is std-lib only; go.mod/go.sum are protected' >&2; exit 2;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; } || true
